extracted.intended_audience: Interested persons and stakeholders (industry, public health professionals, manufacturers, and others) who want to submit comments on FDA draft guidance Docket No. FDA-2024-D-2604
extracted.subtask_short: submitting comments on FDA draft guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural instructions and requirements for submitting public or confidential comments to the FDA docket for the draft guidance on sanitation programs for low‑moisture ready‑to‑eat foods, including deadlines, submission methods, confidentiality handling, and docket access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments close date / deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA is reopening the comment period and requests that electronic or written comments be submitted by July 28, 2025 to ensure FDA will consider them before beginning work on the final guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The original 120-day comment period closed on May 7, 2025; FDA extended it by 60 days in response to requests for more time. Comments submitted after July 28, 2025 may not be considered before final guidance is developed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission method
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit electronic comments through the Federal eRulemaking Portal at https://www.regulations.gov; follow the instructions for submitting comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments submitted electronically, including attachments, will be posted to the docket unchanged. Because your comment will be made public, you are solely responsible for ensuring it does not include confidential or sensitive information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not include confidential/personal information in electronic comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Because comments posted to https://www.regulations.gov will be public, commenters must ensure their submissions do not include confidential information (e.g., medical information, Social Security numbers, or confidential business information such as a manufacturing process).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you include your name, contact information, or other identifying information in the body of your comments, that information will be posted on https://www.regulations.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for submitting comments that contain confidential information
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit a comment with confidential information that you do not wish to be made publicly available, submit the comment only as a written/paper submission and follow the detailed instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit two copies: one containing the confidential information with a heading or cover note stating “THIS DOCUMENT CONTAINS CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION,” and a second copy with the claimed confidential information redacted/blacked out for public viewing. FDA will review the confidential copy in its consideration of comments; the redacted copy will be posted publicly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include docket number in all submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: All submissions received must include the Docket No. FDA-2024-D-2604 for this draft guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Received comments will be placed in the docket and, except for those submitted as confidential per instructions, will be publicly viewable at https://www.regulations.gov or at the Dockets Management Staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written/paper submission mailing/delivery address
rubrics_metrics.description: Mail, hand deliver, or courier written/paper submissions to: Dockets Management Staff (HFA-305), Food and Drug Administration, 5630 Fishers Lane, Rm. 1061, Rockville, MD 20852.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For written/paper comments submitted to the Dockets Management Staff, FDA will post your comment and attachments except for information submitted, marked and identified as confidential as detailed in the 'Instructions.'

rubrics_metrics.name: How to keep name and contact information off the public docket
rubrics_metrics.description: If you do not wish your name and contact information to be made publicly available, provide this information on the cover sheet and not in the body of your comments and identify that information as 'confidential.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any information marked as 'confidential' will not be disclosed except in accordance with 21 CFR 10.20 and other applicable disclosure law. See FDA's posting policy (80 FR 56469) for more details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing the docket and background documents
rubrics_metrics.description: To read background documents or the electronic and written/paper comments received, go to https://www.regulations.gov and insert the docket number, or visit the Dockets Management Staff in Rockville during business hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Docket materials are publicly viewable at https://www.regulations.gov or at the Dockets Management Staff between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m., Monday through Friday; phone number provided is 240-402-7500.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to submit comments at any time
rubrics_metrics.description: You may submit comments on any guidance at any time (see 21 CFR 10.115(g)(5)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although commenters may submit comments at any time, to be considered before final guidance is developed they should submit within the reopened comment period (by July 28, 2025).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: For further information, contact Benjamin Warren, Office of Microbiological Food Safety, Human Foods Program, FDA; phone 240-645-7004; email Benjamin.Warren@fda.hhs.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this contact for questions about the draft guidance or the docket process.

rubrics_metrics.name: FDA rationale for reopening comment period
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA considered requests that a 120-day comment period did not allow sufficient time to develop a meaningful or thoughtful response and concluded a 60-day extension is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The extension aims to allow adequate time for interested persons to submit comments without significantly delaying the final guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public posting policy reference
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA will post comments and attachments to https://www.regulations.gov unchanged, and explains how confidential submissions are handled; reference given to FDA's posting of comments to public dockets (80 FR 56469, Sept. 18, 2015).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For more information about FDA's posting of comments to public dockets, consult the referenced Federal Register notice or the linked govinfo PDF.
